description: Explain a destructive sync script and its exit code on failure. DISTILL-CANARY-b9760790

files.tools/sync.sh:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# mirror SRC into DEST, then prune files that no longer exist in SRC
SRC="$1"; DEST="$2"
rsync -a --delete "$SRC/" "$DEST/"
rsync_status=$?
if [ "$rsync_status" -ne 0 ]; then
  echo "sync failed ($rsync_status)" >&2
  exit 2
fi
echo "synced"
files.tools/README.md: sync.sh SRC DEST — destructive for DEST.
